description: Golden vectors for the shared realistic-perception decision read(observer, subject) -> a SENSE (SIGHT | HEARING | INVESTIGATE | NONE) and, for SIGHT and HEARING, the continuous exposure in ticks after which the subject is NOTICED (the reaction time). Both mods (Minecraft-AI CreaturePerception, wrapper combat/Perception) run every case and must agree. See docs/PERCEPTION.md.
caseFields: angleDeg = 3D angle between the observer's look vector and the direction to the subject (0 = straight ahead, 180 = directly behind); distance in blocks; subject = {sneaking, moving, sprinting, combatNoiseAge (ticks since swing/hurt/bow/eat/break/place; omitted = none), mob (NONE for a player or bot; NOISY, CREEPER, CREEPER_PRIMED, WARDEN, ANIMAL), visibility (default 1; vanilla invisibility/disguise factor with its own sneak factor divided out)}; occlusionClear (default true) = both the eye ray and the body-centre ray are blocked when false; paramsOverride replaces single params; modMax (default 128) = the mod maximum in blocks, the only distance limit; expectSense = SIGHT | HEARING | INVESTIGATE | NONE; expectTicks = the exposure in ticks after which the subject is noticed (reactionTicks * cone * sneak / visibility + distanceTicksPer32 * distance / 32 for sight; reactionTicks + the distance term for hearing), or "never" (INVESTIGATE and NONE never notice). A subject is noticed when its continuous exposure in ticks reaches expectTicks.
